name: track_mission
description: Open the app’s Artemis II trajectory replay in Explore or Orrery. This is an illustrative procedural path, not live spacecraft telemetry, an exact flight path, or verified current mission status. Unavailable in Sky. Only Artemis II is supported; do not offer other missions.

name.description: Artemis II (the only supported trajectory replay). Defaults to Artemis II if omitted.
